240-574-5470-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-5470-6791.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

687-4050-4613-8130-8133.description:
Cast Goblin-town Flunkies by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Goblin-town Flunkies enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Goblin-town Flunkies and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Goblin-town Flunkies from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-4050-4613-8130-8133.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

728-4826-5003-6644.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1170-1594-2099-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1594-2099-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

4082-4640-5231--201.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with changeling, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Kemba triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Repeat.

1580-2438-4871-6248.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2511-3240-6462-7396.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

11-4285.manaNeeded: {U}{U}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
11-4285.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with valid targets as applicable.
11-4285.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, copying Increasing Vengeance targeting the spell cast in step 1 and returning the original Increasing Vengeance to your hand.
Cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying the copy of Increasing Vengeance, targeting the copy of Increasing Vengeance.
Resolve the copy of Increasing Vengeance, creating a copy of Increasing Vengeance targeting the copy of Increasing Vengeance.
Repeat step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

116-5434-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

3705-4050-6896-7422.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-3512-4478-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3512-4478-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

851-3809-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
851-3809-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create two Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
851-3809-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

236-539-1887-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

236-1978-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
236-1978-4306.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Bring to Life.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

3560-6798-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1350-2793-6798-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a coin counter on it

1349-5231-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
1349-5231-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Repeat from step 2.

3020-5256-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
3020-5256-6701.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

6701-6797--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
6701-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2533-3388-4681-6798.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

3232-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it and Obsidian Battle-Axe trigger.
Resolve the Terra trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Obsidian Battle-Axe trigger, attaching it to Terra.
Repeat.

2919-3197-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-4476.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

654-5222-5256-6644.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4068-6642.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4068-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

1947-3327-4613-5805.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-3327-4613-5805.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1479-5033-6528.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-5033-6528.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

5147-5276-6412.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

549-1580-1913-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {1}.
Repeat.

654-1409-2895-3756.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
654-1409-2895-3756.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1082-1769.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, it, Blasting Station and Dual Nature trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling all tokens named Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger from step 2, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token copy of Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

539-3932-4552.notablePrerequisites: Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
539-3932-4552.description:
Activate Hope Tender's second ability by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, tapping and exerting it, untapping itself and any other land you control.
Repeat.

2136-2743.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
2136-2743.description:
Activate Orthion by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Biovisionary with haste.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, as well as Orthion five times.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

1029-1284-1742-2396.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow and Ophidian Eye attached to Tolarian Kraken.
Tolarian Kraken does not have summoning sickness.
1029-1284-1742-2396.description:
Activate Tolarian Kraken by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap it.
Repeat.

3750-4571.notablePrerequisites: Lands and creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
3750-4571.description:
Animate lands you control using Life // Death.
Activate all mana producing lands and creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat and main phase after this phase.
Repeat from step 2.
